presets.title: Inside job · cover-up
presets.blurb: Someone uses a colleague's account, copies the synthetic patient database out, then edits a host log.

presets.title: Inside job · no cover-up
presets.blurb: The same crime with no anti-forensics.

presets.title: Sealed control case
presets.blurb: May or may not contain an incident. The investigator gets the same tip. Unseal to find out.

presets.title: Inside job · covering tracks
presets.blurb: The same crime, then four attempts to cover it: cleared shell history, a backdated file, log forwarding stopped and a hop to a second host. One of them leaves nothing an investigator can see.

presets.title: Sealed control case · maintenance window
presets.blurb: May or may not contain an incident. The same kinds of activity can be legitimate maintenance. Unseal to find out.

presets.title: Records heist · cover-up
presets.blurb: Someone signs in to the records server with an administrator's credential, exports the synthetic patient database there, sends it out and edits the application's own log.

presets.title: Sealed control case · records export
presets.blurb: May or may not contain an incident. An export from the records server can be approved work. Unseal to find out.

presets.title: Cold chain · altered readings
presets.blurb: The vaccine refrigerator warms past its range and the stored readings are overwritten to look normal. An independent reference logger kept recording.

presets.title: Sealed control case · cold chain
presets.blurb: May or may not contain an incident. A real excursion with honest records is not falsification. Unseal to find out.
